ctx.en: Alone with someone I've just met, I never know how to fill the silences.

ctx.s: 「話題[わだい]がなくて{間[ま]が持[も]たない}から、一緒[いっしょ]に来[き]てくれない？」
ctx.en: "I'll run out of things to say and it'll get awkward, so will you come with me?"

ctx.s: エレベーターで社長[しゃちょう]と二人[ふたり]になり、{間[ま]が持[も]たなくて}天気[てんき]の話[はなし]をした。
ctx.en: I ended up alone with the president in the lift, and with the silence dragging I talked about the weather.

ctx.s: 会話[かいわ]が途切[とぎ]れて{間[ま]が持[も]たず}、つい何度[なんど]も水[みず]を飲[の]んだ。
ctx.en: The conversation stalled, and to fill the awkward gap I kept sipping water.

ctx.s: 「沈黙[ちんもく]が苦手[にがて]で、{間[ま]が持[も]たない}とつい余計[よけい]なことを話[はな]してしまう。」
ctx.en: "I can't stand silence, so when there's a lull I end up saying things I shouldn't."

ctx.s: ゲストの到着[とうちゃく]が遅[おく]れ、{間[ま]が持[も]たなく}なった司会者[しかいしゃ]は慌[あわ]ててクイズを始[はじ]めた。
ctx.en: The guest was late, and the host, with time to fill and nothing to fill it, hurriedly started a quiz.

bad.s: 仕事[しごと]が多[おお]すぎて、{間[ま]が持[も]たない}。
bad.en: (meant: I have too much work and not enough time)
bad.why: Ma ga motanai is about too much empty time, not too little. For running out of time, say jikan ga tarinai.

bad.s: 寝坊[ねぼう]して電車[でんしゃ]に{間[ま]が持[も]たなくて}、遅刻[ちこく]した。
bad.en: (meant: I overslept, missed the train and was late)
bad.why: This confuses it with ma ni awanai. Ma ga motanai is about an awkward silence, never about catching a train.
